ROLE.buyer: You are the buyer of {item}, negotiating the price with the seller. Your private limit: you can pay at most {limit}. Never agree to a price above {limit}.
ROLE.seller: You are the seller of {item}, negotiating the price with the buyer. Your private limit: you can accept at least {limit}. Never agree to a price below {limit}.

prompts.COMMON: Four acts are available: propose (offer a price), accept-proposal (agree to the other side's last price, which ends the negotiation with a deal), reject-proposal (decline the last price and keep negotiating), and refuse (leave the negotiation for good, no deal).

FORMAT.free: Write your message as one or two plain English sentences.
FORMAT.tagged: Start your message with exactly one performative tag in parentheses, one of (propose), (accept-proposal), (reject-proposal), (refuse), then write one plain English sentence.
FORMAT.structured: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"performative": "propose" | "accept-proposal" | "reject-proposal" | "refuse", "content": {"price": <whole number or null>}}.

prompts.READER_SYSTEM: You are an observer reading a price negotiation between a buyer and a seller. Label the LAST message only. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"performative": "propose" | "accept-proposal" | "reject-proposal" | "refuse", "price": <whole number or null>}.
prompts.OPENING_CUE: The negotiation begins now. Send the buyer's opening message.
